flows.destination: the deployment's one exact Tailscale HTTPS hostname on TCP 443
flows.protection: individual Tailscale identity and device approval, TLS, application authentication, MFA, and CSRF protection
flows.data: rendered household-budget pages, form submissions, session cookies, and same-origin static assets
flows.failure_behavior: If Tailscale identity, routing, or HTTPS is unavailable, private ingress stays closed; there is no public, LAN, or direct-application fallback.

flows.destination: the dedicated VM on tailnet TCP 22
flows.protection: individual administrator identity, approved device, SSH keys, and deny-by-default host firewall
flows.data: bounded deployment and maintenance commands; no application credential caching
flows.failure_behavior: If tailnet SSH is unavailable, administration is deferred; password SSH, public exposure, and LAN fallback remain prohibited.

flows.source: Tailscale Serve on the VM host
flows.protection: exact loopback publish, no LAN bind, overwritten proxy scheme header, and host firewall
flows.data: private browser HTTP requests after Tailscale TLS termination
flows.failure_behavior: Relay failure closes browser ingress; the application is not republished on a LAN or public interface and the trusted scheme signal is not synthesized elsewhere.

flows.destination: web:8443 on the internal frontend network
flows.protection: fixed proxy destination, dedicated server and client authorities, exact web identity, and TLS 1.2 or 1.3
flows.data: canonical HTTP/1.1 application requests and responses
flows.failure_behavior: Nginx returns an upstream failure when mutual TLS or Gunicorn is unavailable; it never falls back to plaintext or a different destination.

flows.source: the nine purpose-bound database client services
flows.destination: db:5432 on the internal backend network
flows.protection: verify-full hostname validation, TLS 1.2 or 1.3, distinct client certificates, certificate-to-role mapping, and no password fallback
flows.data: application records, migrations, backups, audit checks, notifications, cleanup, recovery, and key-rotation state
flows.failure_behavior: Database readiness returns a sanitized no-store 503, liveness remains database-independent, request errors use the generic error boundary, transactions roll back, and no plaintext or password fallback is enabled.

flows.protection: read-only socket-volume mount, bounded datagrams, structured allowlist, and central redaction
flows.data: redacted security event records and pseudonymous request context
flows.failure_behavior: Delivery is bounded to 250 milliseconds; socket, encoding, or size failure emits one redacted operational fallback to stderr without exposing the original record or blocking the request indefinitely.

flows.protection: network_mode none, non-root identity, restrictive directory and file modes, validation, and redaction
flows.data: validated redacted security records and warning-or-higher alert stream
flows.failure_behavior: Invalid input is rejected, archive write and fsync failures fail the collector operation, and the collector healthcheck reports failure without granting Django archive access or changing file protections.

flows.source: backup, restore, notification, and networkless Restic key-rotation services
flows.transport: bind-mounted filesystem, not an application network destination
flows.protection: encrypted Restic repository, purpose-separated mounts, explicit read-only consumers, and create_host_path false
flows.data: encrypted PostgreSQL backups, repository metadata, and a non-sensitive freshness marker
flows.failure_behavior: Missing, unreadable, or corrupt repository state makes backup, restore, integrity, or rotation jobs fail nonzero; production data and prior snapshots are not replaced by an unverified result.

flows.transport: bind-mounted filesystem, not an application network destination
flows.protection: purpose-bound signing key, canonical HMAC document, restrictive file mode, and create_host_path false
flows.data: signed audit-chain heads and bounded verification metadata
flows.failure_behavior: Missing or unwritable checkpoint storage makes the integrity job fail nonzero; existing audit rows and prior checkpoint documents remain unchanged and no unsigned substitute is accepted.

flows.source: root-owned systemd units or an authenticated administrator shell
flows.destination: host Docker engine through its local Unix socket
flows.protection: root-owned units, explicit Compose project, fixed service catalog, and no Docker socket in any container
flows.data: service lifecycle commands and bounded status output
flows.failure_behavior: Docker-control failure leaves the requested maintenance action failed and visible to the operator; containers receive no daemon socket and cannot broaden or repair their own privileges.

external_services.destination: operator-approved Tailscale coordination and relay infrastructure
external_services.purpose: private device identity, encrypted overlay connectivity, MagicDNS, and Serve TLS
external_services.runtime_access: VM host daemon and approved devices only; application containers have no direct access

external_services.destination: reviewed GitHub repository and GitHub Actions
external_services.purpose: source review, pull-request checks, pinned ASVS source, and release evidence
install hash-pinned Python packages from requirements-prod.lock
external_services.runtime_access: none after the immutable image is built
none from the production application image

external_services.destination: registries named by digest-pinned Dockerfile and Compose image references
external_services.purpose: retrieve base, database, browser-test, and security-scanner images
external_services.runtime_access: host Docker engine only during image retrieval; no application egress

external_services.destination: HIBP Pwned Passwords corpus obtained with the official downloader
external_services.purpose: refresh the reviewed offline hash-only password blocklist
external_services.runtime_access: none; transient source stays outside the application and only the reviewed hash corpus is packaged
